## Claim or change

Describe one coherent change and link the existing claim/scene/issue where relevant.

## Evidence and limits

Link exact source locations; distinguish allegations, findings and interpretation.
For a JSON proposal, use a new file/ID and record corrections with `supersedes`.
Do not claim acceptance or insert a self-review. Editorial decisions require a
separate exact-hash-bound record with genuine provenance.

## Checks

- [ ] No private/sensitive data or unauthorised copies
- [ ] Original research contribution rights confirmed under CC BY-SA 4.0
- [ ] Source/build/data checks run as applicable
- [ ] AI assistance disclosed where applicable

CI and separate release controls remain; no mandatory human PR approval is added.
